videos.texto: Real captures of the site and the site's own artwork; Remotion type; synthetic voice-over. No generated imagery, no real people. In Portuguese.
From raw footage to finished video: cuts on the beat of the speech, captions, sound effects and licensed music, in 9:16. Stock footage; synthetic voice-over. In Portuguese.

One minute of a 16-minute documentary made here: script with the source on screen for every claim, voice-over, animated scenes, motion graphics, music and captions. Faceless. Own piece, no client. In Portuguese.

itens.texto: A public Ultima Online shard (T2A era, on ModernUO), running since 5 September 2026 on a single VPS. Rootless container, image pinned by digest, daily backup with a restore that was actually performed.
Three public-domain files (CC0), no dependencies, no install. Copy one into your repository: it is the instruction set that makes your agent report what it ran, when, and what came back.
How to ask for the work so that proof is possible: goal, state, scope, acceptance, limits, evidence and stop. A public-domain template (CC0).

How you talk to an agent running on a machine you do not control, and how its delivery outlives the session: a repository used as a channel, with the contract inside it. Extracted from a channel that ran for six days with five agents. Public domain (CC0).

The license text ships with the source code.

Symbol, wordmark, copy and videos are Edge Build Labs' own. The video covers are frames from the videos themselves. The player loads from YouTube (youtube-nocookie.com) only after you click; until then nothing leaves this server.

privacidade.meta: Edge Build Labs privacy policy: the site, the contact e-mail and the internal tool that uses Google data.

blocos.html: No trackers, no cookies, no forms. The YouTube player loads only after you click (see Credits).

Messages sent to contato@edgebuildlabs.tech are read in order to be answered, with the help of the tool described below. They are not added to any mailing list and are not used for advertising. WhatsApp messages follow the same rule: read in order to be answered, not added to any mailing list, not used for advertising.

blocos.titulo: Internal e-mail tool and Google data
blocos.html: The operation uses an internal tool, used only by the person who runs it, that accesses the operation's own mailbox through the Gmail API, with the account holder's permission. It reads messages (sender, subject, date, body and attachments) to build a summary of what arrived and, on request, to download an attachment or trigger the unsubscribe link the sender itself publishes. A backup function can create drafts, mark messages as read and apply labels; nothing is sent without the explicit approval of the person who runs the operation, one message at a time. The tool is not offered to the public and does not access anyone else's account.

blocos.titulo: Where the data stays and who it is shared with
blocos.html: On the operation's computer; each reading replaces the previous summary. The only third party is the AI assistant the operation uses (currently Claude, by Anthropic), which reads the summary to help answer, on an account set not to use conversations for model training. We do not sell this data, do not use it for advertising or credit decisions, and do not use it to develop, improve or train generalized AI models.
The use and transfer to any other app of information received from Google APIs will adhere to the Google API Services User Data Policy, including the Limited Use requirements.
For any request about your data, write to contato@edgebuildlabs.tech. The account holder can revoke the tool's access at any time in the Google Account. Last updated 24 September 2026.
